meta.purpose: Local partners (registered bidders/distributors) for African utility tenders + delivered price benchmarks
meta.method: Parallel web search + direct public procurement data: Uganda PPDA GPP API (cdn.ppda.go.ug best-evaluated-bidders, 377 records scanned), Zimbabwe PRAZ eGP award notices (57 scanned) and PRAZ Government Gazette register 4.9.2026, Kenya PPIP/WSP tender opening minutes, ARMP Cameroon, Blantyre Water Board results, World Bank procurement plans. verified=true only if email AND phone each confirmed in two independent sources; partial flags verified_email/verified_phone.
meta.fx_note: USD conversions approximate: KES ~129-130 (2024 & 15.11.2026), UGX ~3,550 (2016-17), NGN ~411 (2021); current fx in model/data/tenders_1511/fx_usd_1511.json
meta.sanctions: No partner found on OFAC SDN by name in open checks (fylings OFAC screen for Oriental Business Group clean 16.10.2026). Chemplex/ZimPhos are Zimbabwean state-linked (IDC) - run formal screening before any deal. Full SDN/EU/UN screening still required before PO.
meta.gaps: Kenya PPIP contract-award data and Tanzania NeST awards not accessible without login/JS; NWSC tonnages for 2024-2026 frameworks not public; no award evidence found for Rwanda (WASAC), Ghana (beyond Alumichem), Nigeria, Cote d'Ivoire, Senegal, Mauritius, Madagascar partners; no recent public delivered price for liquid PAC or polyacrylamide in priority countries.
